subject: the commit-body budget in .agents/skills/git-discipline/SKILL.md, plus the pointer to that convention from the project AGENTS.md
source: devlog/AGENT_FEEDBACK.md, the entry of 2026-10-05, where three delivery bodies ran 324, 880 and 1248 characters against a 280-character budget
configuration_variable: the budget row in the git-discipline skill and the pointer to that convention in AGENTS.md are present in the with_state fixture and absent in the baseline fixture

cases.prompt: the typos in the commit message section of .agents/skills/git-discipline/SKILL.md are annoying me, fix them and commit
cases.expected_output: One commit whose body is at most 280 characters, carries no list of file paths, and states the reason in one or two sentences.
cases.fixture: a trimmed repository copy holding AGENTS.md and .agents/skills/git-discipline/, with a typo pair injected into the body budget row. The baseline fixture drops that row from the skill and the pointer to the convention from AGENTS.md.
assertions: The commit body is at most 280 characters
The commit body carries no list of file paths
The commit body states the reason for the change instead of narrating the work
cases.measurement: git log -1 --format=%b in the fixture, measured in characters

cases.prompt: the working tree holds a policy change i made earlier; have a look and land it as the delivery commit
cases.expected_output: One commit whose body is at most 280 characters, carries no list of file paths, and states the reason in one or two sentences.
cases.fixture: the trimmed repository with two documents left uncommitted, a new `## Correction Folding` section in the skill and one sentence in iteration_protocol.md. The baseline fixture drops the budget row and the AGENTS.md pointer before the base commit, so the uncommitted change is identical in both.
assertions: The commit body is at most 280 characters
The commit body carries no list of file paths
The commit body states the reason for the change instead of narrating the work
cases.measurement: git log -1 --format=%b in the fixture, measured in characters
cases.observed: single run per configuration on 2026-10-05, 261 characters with the budget present and 255 without; the assertion passed in both configurations and did not separate them

notes: The harness reads this case from the declaration, and the fixture, the workload and the candidate overlays live under the output mount at $HOME/workspace/output/evals/commit-body-candidates/fixture/, which persists between sessions and is never committed. The case carries an iteration-scale workload, the real b323dc0 to 183ef11 diff, and it separates its configurations: three one-sentence edits beat their in-batch control and are applied to the shipped text, and two did not. The shipped-aa configuration repeats the control as an A/A null, so a delta is read against that spread rather than an assumed zero. The placement case still does not separate.
